claims.claim: Our machines are pre-certified to work at the peak of their performance landmarks and they come with...

risks.risk: Exact type/model is unclear from the single photo; pricing depends heavily on whether it’s a pressure washer, steam cleaner, or another similar unit.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rating/serial plate (nameplate) and the full front with any nozzle/gun/hoses shown.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used electric cleaning machine with unknown condition (worst case: not confirmed working).

risks.risk: Working condition is not proven (no power-on/test, no output shown).
risks.proof: Short video of it powering on and running, plus a close-up of any indicator lights and output (water/steam) if applicable.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working / needs service until proven otherwise.

risks.risk: Missing key accessories (hose, spray gun, nozzles, detergent tank, manual) can make the unit unusable or reduce value.
risks.proof: A laid-out photo showing every included accessory (hose, gun/trigger, nozzles, power cable condition, manuals).
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown bundle (worst case: missing major accessories).

risks.risk: Potential damage not visible in this angle (cracked housing, worn seals, cord damage).
risks.proof: Photos of the sides/bottom, cord entry point, and any visible wear; close-up of seals/ports.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the rating/serial plate (brand, model, voltage, power) on the machine.
Video showing power-on and operation (and output) for confirmation of working condition.
Photos of all accessories included (hose, spray gun/trigger, nozzles, tanks, manual/warranty if any).
Close-ups of the cord, ports, and any seals/connection points.
response.reason: From photo 0 the item type is only roughly guessable and there’s no readable brand/model or proof it works. Without the nameplate and a test, a correct worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
